conventions.task_A: predict QC-complete free-molecule Gox_ensemble from X0 and the cheap P0
conventions.task_B: given free Gox, predict the coordination shift with X0+X1; B's cost includes the free-label cost
conventions.models: ridge / kernel-ridge and GPR only; direct and shift use identical features, outer split and tuning budget
conventions.splits: random and family-group / LOFO; single-member families in LOFO are difficult cases, not stable estimates
conventions.al_protocol: 12-label pool replay; initial 4 labels, 1 per round, 20 acquisition seeds; random/diversity/uncertainty/ranking-aware
conventions.leakage_guard: hidden labels are used only by the offline evaluator; acquisition/normalisation/tuning must not read them
conventions.success_endpoint: O3>=2/3 and R3<=0.10 eV; tau_b>=0.80 auxiliary; frozen before replay
conventions.expansion_trigger: only after target labels, independent uncertainty, leak-free features and a working replay; add 8-12 molecules, freeze before computing
